extracted.name: Oreo Pie
extracted.description: This Oreo pie recipe uses America’s favorite chocolate sandwich cookies, milk, pudding mix, baked pie shell, and frozen whipped topping to make this pie.
ingredient_lines: 2 (3.9 ounce) packages instant chocolate pudding mix
1 (14 ounce) package chocolate sandwich cookies (such as Oreo®), crushed
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Beat milk and pudding mix together in a large bowl with an electric mixer until thick and smooth, about 2 minutes. Add crushed cookies; stir to combine.
Refrigerate pudding mixture until partially set, about 10 minutes.
Spread pudding mixture into baked pie crust; top with whipped topping.
